destination.title: Extremal black holes: attractors, entropy, spectra and consistency
destination.question: How do charges, scalar geometry, supersymmetry and quantum effects determine extremal black-hole solutions, entropy, nearby spectra, thermodynamics and stability?
destination.summary: The candidate membership is useful at family scale. It does not establish shared asymptotics, dimensions, ensembles, coupling prescriptions or a universal BPS mechanism. Foundational attractor work and the supplied higher-derivative and attractor probes belong naturally within this family. Adjacent extremality tests remain accessible without becoming premises of the core questions.

systems: BPS and non-BPS extremal black holes in the supplied supergravity and string settings
Black strings where attractor uniqueness and recombination are explicitly asked
Charged particles and dual field theories as probes, microscopic descriptions or comparison systems
targets: Macroscopic entropy, microscopic counting and protected indices
BPS thermodynamic limits and phase structure
Quantum corrections, EFT validity and non-BPS stability
regimes: Perturbative and non-perturbative corrections in their stated approximations
assumptions: Numerical membership supplies candidate relevance only
Supersymmetry, regularity, ensembles and coupling assumptions remain source-specific
conventions: An index, an ungraded partition function and an energy-window degeneracy are distinct observables
Boundary and near-horizon descriptions are related only where the supplied evidence states the relation
includes: Ordinary and foundational work without a Swampland premise
Charged-spectrum and geometric extremality questions as overlap
Cosmological-deformation thermodynamics through a labeled alternate home
excludes: A universal gap or universal index-to-degeneracy equality
An unconditional obstruction to black holes preserving more than four supercharges
Treating WGC interpretations as established premises
Fine-question equivalence inferred from common family membership

sources.title: Black hole microstates in AdS$_{4}$ from supersymmetric localization

evidence.text: Can the topologically twisted ABJM index account microscopically for the entropy of static supersymmetric magnetic AdS4 black holes, and does extremization select the R-symmetry of the horizon quantum mechanics?

sources.title: Four-dimensional black hole entropy from F-theory

evidence.text: Can six-dimensional F-theory supergravity reproduce the microscopic central charges and current levels governing four-dimensional BPS black-hole entropy, including charge-dependent corrections beyond the classical near-horizon reduction?

sources.title: Conformal symmetries for extremal black holes with general asymptotic scalars in STU supergravity

evidence.text: How can general static BPS STU black holes be expressed explicitly with eight charges and six arbitrary asymptotic scalar values, and how does Couch–Torrence-type conformal inversion act on this fourteen-parameter family?

sources.title: Non-BPS black branes in M-theory over Calabi-Yau threefolds. (Non-)uniqueness and recombination of non-BPS black strings in single modulus CICY and THCY models

evidence.text: For fixed supporting charges, are extremal non-BPS black-hole and black-string attractors unique, and can their BPS/anti-BPS constituents recombine into energetically stable objects?

sources.title: BPS and near-BPS black holes in AdS$_{5}$ and their spectrum in $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 SYM

evidence.text: Does the near-1/16-BPS AdS5 black-hole spectrum have a power-law-suppressed gap above BPS states, and can gravitational quantum corrections explain their degeneracy and the absence of cancellations in the superconformal index?

sources.title: The dark (BPS) side of thermodynamics in Minkowski$_{4}$

evidence.text: Can asymptotically flat black-hole thermodynamics admit a well-defined BPS limit beyond static extremality, and does its mixed-ensemble action explain the OSV formula and support a fixed-point interpretation?

sources.title: Black hole microstate counting from the gravitational path integral

evidence.text: Can the gravitational path integral reproduce the exact integer index of fixed-charge 1/8-BPS black holes, including exponentially suppressed saddles, and also determine their degeneracy within a near-extremal energy window?

sources.title: Mixed ’t Hooft anomalies and the Witten effect for AdS black holes

evidence.text: How does a graviphoton θ term change the BPS index, charge spectrum and near-BPS degeneracies of dyonic AdS4 black holes, especially at the potentially anomalous point θ*=π?

sources.title: Can black holes preserve 𝒩 > 4 supersymmetry?

evidence.text: Which effective theories can describe near-BPS black-hole dynamics and spectra, and under what physical assumptions does their classification obstruct black holes preserving more than four supercharges?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture and Black Holes in N = 2 Supergravity

evidence.text: Do charged BPS-particle loops produce problematic extremal-black-hole entropy corrections even in N = 2 supergravity with nonminimal interactions, and can a magnetic weak-gravity cutoff or the string-theory interpretation of BPS states explain their avoidance?

sources.title: Black hole microstates in AdS$_{4}$ from supersymmetric localization

evidence.text: Numerical BAE solutions motivate a continuum eigenvalue ansatz. The authors extremize a dilogarithmic Bethe potential, balance large-N terms to obtain imaginary eigenvalues scaling as √N, and evaluate the residue expression on the resulting density and tail solutions.

sources.title: Four-dimensional black hole entropy from F-theory

evidence.text: Reality conditions restrict the sum to jL3≥0; the quotient keeps jL3=mk/2 with integer k≥0. Sum over representations containing each retained weight, then over k, using zeta-function regularization of the infinite KK towers.

sources.title: Conformal symmetries for extremal black holes with general asymptotic scalars in STU supergravity

evidence.text: Package charges into a tensor with one doublet index for each SL(2,R). Introduce asymptotic moduli into metric coefficients by replacing Kronecker deltas with asymptotic scalar matrices; epsilon-only contractions remain unchanged.

sources.title: Non-BPS black branes in M-theory over Calabi-Yau threefolds. (Non-)uniqueness and recombination of non-BPS black strings in single modulus CICY and THCY models

evidence.text: Introduce non-BPS deviations X_I=q_I−Z_e C_{IJK}t^Jt^K and X^I=p^I−Z_m t^I. Solve their orthogonality constraints first, then determine an overall factor from contracted attractor equations; vanishing deviations identify BPS points.

sources.title: BPS and near-BPS black holes in AdS$_{5}$ and their spectrum in $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 SYM

evidence.text: Use the imported one-loop-exact super-Schwarzian partition function, then Fourier/Laplace decomposition into charge sectors and energies. Killing-spinor bilinears and spinorial Lie derivatives determine the near-horizon superalgebra.

sources.title: The dark (BPS) side of thermodynamics in Minkowski$_{4}$

evidence.text: Take the BPS limit of the quantum statistical relation, subtract extremal reference potentials, and use the BPS first law to identify conjugate variables. Legendre transform magnetic potentials to obtain the ensemble with fixed magnetic charges and fluctuating electric charges.

sources.title: How to (Non-)Perturb a BPS Black Hole

evidence.text: How do charged BPS probes in a black hole attractor geometry explain the non-perturbative structure of higher-derivative corrections to its free energy and entropy? This proceedings article primarily reviews earlier work and adds comments on contour contributions and ongoing questions.

sources.title: The statistical mechanics of near-BPS black holes

evidence.text: Does the gravitational path integral explain a gap above BPS black holes and an exactly degenerate extremal sector, resolving the failure of semiclassical thermodynamics around T~1/Φr?

sources.title: The phase diagram of BPS black holes in AdS$_{5}$

evidence.text: How does rotating AdS5 black-hole thermodynamics approach the BPS sector, and how do independent BPS fugacities, including one absent from the protected index, change its phase diagram?

sources.title: Black hole entropy, quantum corrections and EFT transitions

evidence.text: Can protected BPS black hole entropy characterize a transition between four- and five-dimensional EFT descriptions, remaining well defined when the local higher-derivative expansion fails at the Kaluza–Klein scale?

sources.title: Corrections to AdS$_{5}$ black hole thermodynamics from higher-derivative supergravity

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric four-derivative corrections change charged, rotating AdS5 black-hole thermodynamics, and do the corrected action and BPS entropy match the dual superconformal index?

sources.title: Gravitational index, black hole saddle degeneracy, and one-form symmetry

evidence.text: How does a four-dimensional SCFT's discrete one-form symmetry produce degenerate black-hole saddles and a +log|G| contribution to the gravitational index, at finite and infinite spatial volume?

sources.title: Extremal black holes in supergravity

evidence.text: How do scalar geometry, supersymmetry and electric-magnetic duality determine four-dimensional extremal black-hole attractors, their entropy, and the distinction between BPS and non-BPS solutions?

sources.title: Supersymmetry and attractors

evidence.text: Can the horizon area and entropy of supersymmetric extremal black holes be obtained by extremizing the central charge over moduli, explaining their independence from asymptotic scalar values?

sources.title: Entropy functional and the holographic attractor mechanism

evidence.text: Can the attractor mechanism for asymptotically AdS4 BPS black holes be formulated entirely through boundary field-theory data, explaining the entropy functional and its extremization in twisted ABJM?

sources.title: Macroscopic entropy of N=2 extremal black holes

evidence.text: How do the horizon moduli and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of smooth four-dimensional N=2 BPS black holes depend on general electric and magnetic charges, extending the previously studied magnetic case?

sources.title: Merging the weak gravity and distance conjectures using BPS extremal black holes

evidence.text: Can precise extremality calculations require non-BPS particles or constrain non-holomorphic cycle volumes? Does BPS convex-hull sufficiency extend beyond the examples?

sources.title: Decay channels for double extremal black holes in four dimensions

evidence.text: Which non-BPS double-extremal black holes admit energetically favorable decays into BPS and anti-BPS constituents, and how do effective-divisor cones and partial curvature-squared corrections affect those channels?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Does the heterotic spectrum contain charged states lighter than macroscopic non-BPS extremal black holes?

sources.title: Constraints on LVS Compactifications of IIB String Theory

evidence.text: Which versions of type IIB LVS remain phenomenologically viable after imposing effective-supergravity validity, flavor constraints, nonperturbative matter couplings and cosmology? The author argues that a sequestered scenario with Weyl-anomaly and RG-generated soft terms is favored.

sources.title: On the F-term problem and quintessence supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry breaking from rolling quintessence, mediated through kinetic couplings, generate substantial scalar and Majorana gaugino masses without spoiling slow roll or introducing pathological kinetic terms?

sources.title: Mixed Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking with Anomalous U(1) Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: How do the characteristics and stabilization of anomalous-U(1) D-flat directions determine the relative contributions of modulus, gauge, anomaly and D-term mediation in vacua with nearly vanishing cosmological constant?

sources.title: Mixed Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking with Anomalous U(1) Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: Model sequestered uplifting through a nonlinear Goldstino/Volkov–Akulov sector, giving V_lift=M^4 exp(2K/3) in Einstein frame. The uplift must be included explicitly when a relevant D-flat direction has mass comparable to or below m_3/2.

sources.title: Constraints on LVS Compactifications of IIB String Theory

evidence.text: The supercovariant derivative expansion counts derivatives, fermion bilinears and auxiliary F terms together. The author requires |F|/M²≪1 as well as small derivatives and fermion bilinears, with M the lowest integrated-out mass scale.

sources.title: On the F-term problem and quintessence supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Evaluate kinetic interactions on a homogeneous rolling background and canonically normalize spectator fluctuations to extract effective mass contributions. Goldstino–gravitino mixing identifies the rolling scalar's fermion as a contributor to supersymmetry breaking.

sources.title: Mixed Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking with Anomalous U(1) Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: Use supergravity auxiliary-field identities and scalar-potential stationarity to relate modulus F-components, charged-matter F-components and D_A. Explicit examples additionally impose vanishing vacuum energy and examine local stability.

sources.title: Mixed Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking with Anomalous U(1) Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: In the small- and large-R1 limits, integrate out the heavy vector multiplet using ∂K/∂V_H=0. The resulting effective Kähler interactions describe the light D-flat field; radiative examples balance their quartic potential against an anomaly-mediated quadratic term.

sources.title: Constraints on LVS Compactifications of IIB String Theory

evidence.text: Matter metrics and sectional curvatures are expanded at large volume and inserted into m²_(αβ̄)=(V0+m²_(3/2))K_(αβ̄)−F^iF^(j̄)R_(ij̄αβ̄). Canonical normalization separates flavor-universal and flavor-violating pieces; A-term alignment or suppression is also considered.

sources.title: SUSY phenomenology of KKLT flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can KKLT-motivated mixed modulus–anomaly mediation with the MSSM on D7 branes yield acceptable electroweak breaking, a viable superpartner spectrum, and neutralino dark matter under the paper's experimental and cosmological constraints?

sources.title: Cosmological aspects of gauge mediated supersymmetry breakdown

evidence.text: Under what conditions can gauge-mediated supersymmetry breaking survive early-universe evolution: selection of a metastable SUSY-breaking vacuum, decay of the spurion, thermal stability of a volume modulus, and acceptable gravitino production?

sources.title: Sparticle spectrum and EWSB of mixed modulus-anomaly mediation in fluxed string compactification models

evidence.text: How does comparable modulus and anomaly mediation in KKLT compactifications affect the low-energy sparticle spectrum, electroweak symmetry breaking, and the composition of a possible neutralino dark-matter candidate?

sources.title: Phenomenology of mixed modulus-anomaly mediation in fluxed string compactifications and brane models

evidence.text: What low-energy sparticle spectra and electroweak symmetry breaking follow when nonperturbative modulus stabilization and sequestered uplifting produce comparable modulus- and anomaly-mediated soft terms?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking at Low Energies

evidence.text: How can dynamical, possibly metastable supersymmetry breaking at low energies produce viable gauge-mediated soft terms, address flavor and hierarchy problems, and motivate possible collider phenomenology?

sources.title: Out of this world supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry breaking away from the visible brane naturally suppress flavor-dependent soft terms while unavoidable anomaly-mediated contributions generate viable, predictive gaugino and scalar masses?

sources.title: Compactified String Theories -- Generic Predictions for Particle Physics

evidence.text: Which correlated particle-physics and dark-matter predictions follow from compactified string/M theory under low-energy supersymmetry, grand unification and cosmological constraints?

sources.title: Brane world SUSY breaking

evidence.text: Does physically separating visible matter and supersymmetry breaking on different branes enforce a sequestered Kähler potential, suppress tree-level scalar masses, and make anomaly mediation a generic solution to the supersymmetric flavor problem?

sources.title: 50 years of SUSY and SUGRA, circa 1974–2024 and future prospects

evidence.text: Review how SUSY, local supersymmetry, gravity-mediated breaking and SUGRA grand unification developed, and assess their particle-physics, cosmological and string-theory motivations and experimental prospects.

sources.title: Is gauge mediation in the swampland?

evidence.text: Does the proposed global festina lente (GFL) bound constrain supersymmetry-breaking mediation to the supersymmetric Standard Model, particularly gauge mediation, and which mechanisms evade the constraint when gravity decouples?

sources.title: Cosmological implications of dynamical supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Which dynamical supersymmetry-breaking scenarios can generate the weak/Planck hierarchy while satisfying particle phenomenology, a tuned small cosmological constant, and early-universe cosmology?

sources.title: Light Higgsinos for electroweak naturalness in mirage-mediated high-scale supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can KKLT-inspired mirage mediation retain percent-level electroweak naturalness with multi-TeV superpartners, while allowing light Higgsinos consistent with gauge coupling unification and the observed Higgs mass?

sources.title: Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking in a Class of String Theory Models

evidence.text: Can a minimal moduli-plus-MSSM string effective theory generate flavor-suppressed soft terms, acceptable Higgs parameters, and gaugino masses while including supergravity quadratic divergences and tuning the cosmological constant?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking in Local String/F-Theory Models

evidence.text: How strongly does bulk LARGE-volume supersymmetry breaking generate gravity and anomaly mediated soft terms on local Standard Model/GUT branes, and what follows for gauge mediation and the cosmological moduli problem?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravity consistency constrain the gravitino Lagrangian mass and thereby inform the supersymmetry-breaking scale? The motivating near-Minkowski estimate is M_SUSY² ≃ m_{3/2}M_P.

sources.title: Modulus-dominated SUSY-breaking soft terms in F-theory and their test at LHC

evidence.text: Which MSSM soft-term patterns follow from Kähler-modulus-dominated supersymmetry breaking, and which survive radiative electroweak breaking, the paper's experimental and dark-matter constraints, and prospective LHC tests?

sources.title: The Intermediate scale branch of the landscape

evidence.text: Can the intermediate-scale landscape branch yield generic, conditional predictions for moduli and superpartner spectra, and can dark-matter selection explain apparent weak-scale tuning?

sources.title: Little SUSY hierarchy in mixed modulus-anomaly mediation

evidence.text: Can KKLT-motivated mixed modulus-anomaly mediation generate loop-suppressed Higgs soft masses relative to sparticle masses, together with viable µ and B, addressing the little hierarchy motivated by the paper's contemporary MSSM Higgs bound?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Which supersymmetry-breaking contributions can cancel a small negative vacuum energy without overwhelming the non-perturbatively generated gravitino scale? The source explores existing uplift proposals and their compatibility with flux-stabilized sectors.

sources.title: Natural Heavy Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can cosmological relaxation scan supersymmetry breaking and dynamically explain a weak scale far below superpartner masses, while supersymmetry protects scalar naturalness at higher energies?

sources.title: Cosmology of F-theory GUTs

evidence.text: Uses FRW expansion, freeze-out estimates H≈n<σv>, Boltzmann equations and yields Y=n/s to estimate thermal relics. Coherent-modulus evolution and entropy injection supply the dilution calculation. These standard ingredients are explicitly reviewed before their application.

sources.title: Cosmological aspects of gauge mediated supersymmetry breakdown

evidence.text: Uses cosmological field evolution with Hubble friction for modulus dynamics, and a Boltzmann equation for production of incoherent gravitational relics. These are recorded as methods presented in the source, without reproducing their calculations.

sources.title: A Gravitino-rich Universe

evidence.text: Estimate decay widths, yields and entropy dilution, then use a post-injection Boltzmann equation with ⟨σv⟩=cχ/mχ² to determine whether neutralino annihilation erases dependence on the injected abundance.

sources.title: Cosmology of F-theory GUTs

evidence.text: Expands the superspace effective action and integrates out heavy PQ gauge fields to estimate saxion couplings and decay widths. The working relation m_sax=4Δ_PQ is a rough estimate; its coefficient depends on Kähler-potential details and order-one tunings.

sources.title: Cosmological aspects of gauge mediated supersymmetry breakdown

evidence.text: Uses messenger integration, wave-function renormalization and RG equations with analytic continuation into superspace to describe soft masses; Coleman–Weinberg corrections lift the spurion pseudomodulus.

sources.title: Cosmological aspects of gauge mediated supersymmetry breakdown

evidence.text: Studies finite-temperature effective potentials, thermal masses, free-energy preference for light degrees of freedom, and classical transitions versus barrier-suppressed tunneling between vacua.
